visual_action: An animated infographic displays a map of the United States. Throughout the clip, various states are colored in with yellow, orange, and dark red to illustrate potential prison sentences for doctors who perform abortions if Roe v. Wade were to be overturned. A key at the bottom of the screen explains the color coding for different lengths of prison sentences.

cast.name: Center for Reproductive Rights
cast.evidence: The text "Sources: Center for Reproductive Rights, State Laws" appears on screen.

on_screen_text.text: IF ROE V. WADE FALLS, DOCTORS COULD FACE PRISON TIME FOR PERFORMING ABORTIONS
Sources: Center for Reproductive Rights, State Laws

spoken_summary: The video contains no spoken dialogue, only instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, somber piano instrumental plays throughout the video, creating a serious and alarming tone. The music is an instrumental cover of the song "Where Is My Mind?"
editing_pacing: The video is an animated infographic. The pacing is slow and deliberate as different states on a map are colored in sequentially to represent data.
cultural_references: The background music is an instrumental version of the song "Where Is My Mind?" by the Pixies.
central_claim: If Roe v. Wade is overturned, doctors in numerous states could face lengthy prison sentences, up to life, for performing abortions.
intended_effect: To alarm viewers about the potential legal ramifications for doctors if abortion is criminalized and to motivate them to support the protection of abortion access.
